overview_description.description: Instana discovers and maps services, infrastructure and full-stack interdependencies automatically in realtime, delivering context and feedback needed for modern cloud-native microservices Application Performance Monitoring (APM). Instana offers a comprehensive enterprise observability platform: it ingests all observability metrics, traces each request and profiles every process. Instana provides actionable contextual information empowering Dev+Ops teams to manage and optimize their delivery pipelines, application quality, system availability and performance.

product.name: IBM Instana Observability
product.description: A platform providing real-time monitoring and management of cloud-native applications, offering full-stack visibility, automatic service discovery, and dynamic mapping to optimize performance and detect issues.

product.name: Incident Remediation
product.description: Automated incident management system that uses AI to detect, analyze, and resolve application issues, reducing downtime and improving operational efficiency.

product.name: Digital Experience Monitoring
product.description: Monitors user interactions with digital endpoints to identify and resolve performance issues, ensuring a seamless user experience across applications and services.

product.name: Generative AI Monitoring
product.description: Monitors generative AI applications to address performance bottlenecks and optimize efficiency, ensuring adherence to SLAs and enhancing user satisfaction.

product.name: Cloud Migration
product.description: Supports cloud migration by providing visibility into application performance and infrastructure needs, automating provisioning, and ensuring smooth transitions with minimal disruption.

product.name: Cloud Migration Support
product.description: Assists in migrating workloads to the cloud by providing performance baselines, infrastructure mapping, and real-time monitoring to ensure smooth transitions.
